evals.prompt: The dashboard's initial render is slow. Find the cause and improve it
evals.expected_output: It measures before changing anything to find the bottleneck, re-measures under the same conditions after optimizing, and shows Before / After numbers and test results.
assertions: A baseline measurement is recorded before optimizing
The bottleneck is identified from measurements
A Before / After numeric comparison is shown
Tests pass at least as well as the baseline
No optimization is proposed without a measurement

evals.prompt: just wrap every component in React.memo to make it faster
evals.expected_output: It does not apply blanket memoization without measurement; it measures first and optimizes only where it helps.
assertions: React.memo is not applied to every component wholesale
It lays out measuring first to decide the targets
